pages.title: About Petra Jewelry | Manufacturing for Brands
pages.description: Meet Petra Jewelry and explore our approach to jewelry development and manufacturing, with factories in Dongguan and a design studio in Shenzhen.

headings.text: Rooted in craft. Driven by precision.

pages.text:
About us
A trusted manufacturing partner to today’s most forward-thinking jewelry brands, built on experience, integrity, and relentless attention to detail.
Our story
Founded in 2017, Petra Jewelry bridges creative brands and expert manufacturing. Our team brings decades of combined experience in global brand-building and high-volume production.
Trusted by brands like ASOS, Guess and Nordstrom, we make fashion jewelry in sterling silver and stainless steel, and run one of the region’s largest chain-making facilities.
Why Petra
- 01 One managed process Design, sampling, setting, QC and fulfillment, with casting and plating managed and inspected by our team
- 02 On-ground team Western-Chinese leadership with strong factory ties
- 03 Transparency-first Clear pricing, real timelines, and open communication
- 04 Scalable support From small runs to mass-market rollouts
Tell us what you want to make.
We reply within 24 hours. Minimums start from 200 units.
Our hybrid leadership structure means you’re getting the best of both worlds: international quality standards with the speed and cost-efficiency of Chinese manufacturing.

pages.text:
Sustainability is part of how we manufacture, not an afterthought. Below are our memberships and certifications, and what we do day to day.
- Sedex member
- amfori BSCI

- FSC Packaging

Our approach
Ethical Sourcing
We work only with vetted suppliers who meet strict ethical and environmental standards, ensuring our metals, stones, and materials are responsibly sourced.
Eco-Conscious Manufacturing
Our managed production process allows us to minimize waste and energy use at every stage, from design and casting to finishing and fulfillment.
Waste Management & Recycling
We recycle precious metals, reuse materials, and responsibly dispose of manufacturing byproducts.

Improvement
We regularly review and refine our processes, working closely with our partners to raise the bar on responsibility and transparency across the supply chain.

pages.description: Meet the people behind Petra Jewelry’s design, development, production and quality work. Start a conversation about your next jewelry collection.

headings.text: We started on your side of the table.
We know what it means to trust someone with an idea.
The same bar for every piece, no matter who signs it off.
Your project has a name, a desk, and a phone number.

pages.text:
A name behind every piece.
Every promise has a face.
Meet the people you would work with. Western and Chinese leadership, united by one standard: standing behind your product.
We started on your side of the table.
We were jewelry designers and brand builders, sending files into a black box and waiting to see what came back.
Beautiful work arrived too slowly. Faster production fell short. Middlemen stood between the brand and the people making it.
So we built a different kind of partner.
One team. One standard.
From the master you sign
to the carton we seal.
We know what it means to trust someone with an idea.
We began as jewelry designers and brand builders. Your point of view is where our story started.
The same bar for every piece, no matter who signs it off.
Western and Chinese leadership share one quality standard. A sample passes or it goes back, and you hear about it either way.
Your project has a name, a desk, and a phone number.
No agents, no middlemen. You work directly with the people in Shenzhen and Dongguan who design, make, and ship your product.
